## Intended Outcome

Generate audit and export new Step12 deliverables for BTeam and Vivacom from their designated source folders while preserving earlier work.

## Why This Looks Repeatable

Each promoted Step12 upgrade needs complete client delivery validation beyond targeted recovery.

## Required Inputs, Auth, Or Environment

- The completed BTeam and Vivacom upstream states whose four source documents and locked ideas match their designated folders.

## Commands And Observations

| step | command or action | result | correction or note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| run-both-step12 | python3 Tasks/step12-two-clients-e2e-20260907/run_both.py | Two saved child runs with honest Step12 acceptance results and exported deliverables only after the roadmap gate passes. | GPT5.5 high with600 second per-call limits and one attempt; full Step12 restart only with earlier phases preserved. |
| record-correction | python3 scripts/work_memory.py correct --run-id <run-id> --blocker-id <blocker-id> --occurrence-id <occurrence-id> --step-id <step-id> --changed-artifact <path> --solution <solution> --reusable-behavior-changed yes | required after selected-bundle drift | Use only when the selected controller remains unchanged. |
| record-protected-correction | python3 scripts/work_memory_bootstrap.py correct --task-id <task-id> --run-id <run-id> --blocker-id <blocker-id> --occurrence-id <occurrence-id> --step-id <step-id> --changed-artifact <path> --solution <solution> --reusable-behavior-changed yes | required after protected selected-bundle drift | Use the activated sealed controller through the canonical guard. |

## Failure Handling

Preserve each saved child and telemetry on failure and do not repeat whole generation automatically.

## Verified Path

- Inspect fresh model-call telemetry acceptance and exports and byte equivalence of completed earlier phases.
